name: Daily Drama: The Benchmark Bake-Off
author: Daily Drama (fixture)
description: Every lab tops a leaderboard today, each on a benchmark it wrote that morning.

add.title: A Rival Tops a Benchmark It Invented at Breakfast
add.body:
Open-ish AI scored 100% on Open-ish Bench, which it released 20 minutes before the results.
The press wants to know which benchmark you're winning.

choices.label: Invent our own benchmark and win it

effects.text: Lab sets record on benchmark it announced during the livestream
Real benchmarks are hard. That's why nobody uses them.
Lab retires from benchmarks 'while still undefeated'

add.text: Open-ish AI sets record on Open-ish Bench, which it released 20 minutes earlier
Anthropomorphic tops its own honesty eval, admits this is a bit awkward
MetaMeta claims top spot on a leaderboard where it is the only entry
Macrohard benchmark measures how well models fill in spreadsheet cells; Macrohard wins
Sirocco posts its scores as a torrent; seeders report 'basically superintelligent, trust us'
New benchmark ranks benchmarks by how easy they are to win
I wrote the test, and the answers, and then we passed. Science.
Our loss curve looks great if you tilt your head.
Which benchmark are you winning? All of them? Great, sign me up.
I trained on the test set. I prefer to call it a study group.
We shipped! Now I invent the benchmark we're best at.
